entities.summary: Popeye Village is a film set experience destination in Mellieħa, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A preserved film-set village whose physical environment and activities make it a genuinely unusual Malta-specific experience. This entry is intended for 4–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
